segments.orig:
âat ýat dâuru upa-darane vâ nimatô
aiwi-varane vâ spâ vâ nâ vâ irithyât
kutha tê verezyãn aête ýôi mazdayasna.
segments.en:
If a dog or a man die under a hut of wood or a hut of felt
what shall the worshippers of Mazda do?
segments.zh: 若在木屋或毛氈屋下死了狗或人，馬茲達的祭祀者應當做什麼？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, upairi daxma aêshayãn
vî daxma caêshayãn, ýezi aêtem
iristem upa-berethwôtarem ava-zanãn ava aêtem
iristem barayen avatha nmânem herezayen upa aêtem
nmânem baodhayãn urvâsnayå vâ vohu-gaonahe
vâ vohu-keretôish vâ hadhânaêpatayå
vâ kãmcit vâ hubaoidhitemanãm urvaranãm.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'They shall search for a Dakhma, they
shall look for a Dakhma all around. If they find it easier to
remove the dead, they shall take out the dead, they shall let
the house stand, and shall perfume it with Urvasna or Vohu-gaona,
or Vohu-kereti, or Hadha-naepata, or any other sweet-smelling
plant.
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『他們應當搜尋寂靜之塔，應當四處尋找寂靜之塔。若他們發現搬運亡者更容易，他們應當取出亡者，應當讓房屋保持原狀，並應當用烏爾瓦斯那或沃胡‧高那或沃胡‧克雷提或哈達‧涅帕塔或任何其他香氣怡人的植物薰香。

segments.orig:
ýezi aêtem nmânem upa-berethwôtarem
ava- zanãn ava aêtem nmânem barayen avatha
iristem herezayen upa aêtem nmânem baodhayãn
urvâsnayå vâ ... urvaranãm.
segments.en:
'If they find it easier to remove the house, they shall take
away the house, they shall let the dead lie on the spot, and shall
perfume the house with Urvasna, or Vohu-gaona, or Vohu-kereti,
or Hadha-naepata, or any other sweet-smelling plant.'
 
 II
segments.zh: 『若他們發現搬運房屋更容易，他們應當搬走房屋，應當讓亡者留在原處，並應當用烏爾瓦斯那或沃胡‧高那或沃胡‧克雷提或哈達‧涅帕塔或任何其他香氣怡人的植物薰香房屋。』

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum ýat ahmi nmâne
ýat mâzdayasnôish spâ vâ nâ
vâ irithyât vâreñti vâ snaêzhiñti
vâ bareñti vâ temanghãm vâ aiwi-gâtô
ayãn vâ varetafshô varetô-vîre
jaseñti kutha tê verezyãn aête ýôi
mazdayasna.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If in the house
of a worshipper of Mazda a dog or a man happens to die, and it
is raining, or snowing, or blowing, or
it is dark, or the day is at its end, when flocks and men lose
their way, what shall the worshippers of Mazda do?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！若在馬茲達祭祀者的房屋中死了狗或人，且正值下雨或下雪或颳風或天色黑暗或日近黃昏，牲畜與人類迷失方向之時，馬茲達的祭祀者應當做什麼？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, ýat ahmi nmâne
ýat mâzdayasnôish fraêshtem ... thrigâim
haca nerebyô ashavabyô.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'The place in that house whereof the
ground is the cleanest and the driest, and the least passed through
by flocks and herds, by the fire of Ahura Mazda, by the consecrated
bundles of Baresma, and by the faithful;'-
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! How far from
the fire? How far from the water? How far from the consecrated
bundles of Baresma? How far from the faithful?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Thirty paces from the fire; thirty
paces from the water; thirty paces from the consecrated bundles
of Baresma; three paces from the faithful;-
segments.zh:
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『那房屋中地面最潔淨、最乾燥、最少被牲畜與牛群、阿胡拉‧馬茲達的火、供奉的巴雷斯瑪束及信徒經過的地方——』
物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！距離火多遠？距離水多遠？距離供奉的巴雷斯瑪束多遠？距離信徒多遠？
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『距離火三十步；距離水三十步；距離供奉的巴雷斯瑪束三十步；距離信徒三步——

segments.orig:
aêtadha hê aête mazdayasna ainghå
zemô ava-kanem ava-kanayen maidhyôi paitishtâne
xrûzhdisme maidhyôi narsh varedusme ava hê gâtûm
barayen âtryehe vâ sairyehe vâ ava hê
uparât naêmât barayen ishtyehe vâ zarshtvahe
vâ hushô-zemanãm vâ pãsnûm.
segments.en:
'On that place they shall dig a grave, half a foot deep if
the earth be hard, half the height of a man if it be soft; [they
shall cover the surface of the grave with ashes or cowdung]; they
shall cover the surface of it with dust of bricks, of stones,
or of dry earth.
segments.zh: 『他們應當在該處挖掘墓穴，若土地堅硬則深半足，若土地柔軟則深至人身高之半；〔他們應當用灰燼或牛糞覆蓋墓穴表面〕；他們應當用磚屑、石屑或乾土覆蓋其表面。

segments.orig:
aêtadha hê uzbaodhãm tanûm nidaithyãn
bixshaparem vâ thrixshaparem vâ mâzdrâjahîm
vâ vîspem â ahmât ýat frâ
vayô patãn frâ urvara uxshyãn nyåñcô
apa-tacin us vâtô zãm haêcayât.
segments.en:
'And they shall let the lifeless body lie there, for two nights,
or three nights, or a month long, until the birds begin to fly,
the plants to grow, the hidden floods to flow, and the wind to
dry up the earth.
segments.zh: 『他們應當讓無生命的軀體在那裡躺置二夜、三夜或一個月之久，直至鳥兒開始飛翔、植物開始生長、隱匿的洪水開始流動、風開始乾燥大地。

segments.orig:
âat ýat hîsh frâ vayô patãn
frâ urvara uxshyãn nyåñcô apa-tacin
us vâtô zãm haêcayât aêtadha
hê aête mazdayasna ahe nmânahe upa-thweresãn
upa-thweresayãn, dva dim nara isôithe vîzôishtãm
vîzvâreñtãm makhna anaiwi-vastra zemôishtve
vâ zarshtve vâ upa-skañbem vîcicaêshva
dim paiti ainghå zemô nidaithyãn ýadhôit
dim bâidhishtem avazanãn sûnô vâ
kerefsh-hvarô vayô vâ kerefsh-hvarô.
segments.en:
'And when the birds begin to fly, the plants to grow, the
hidden floods to flow, and the wind to dry up the earth, then
the worshippers of Mazda shall make a breach in the wall of the
house, and two men, strong and skillful,
having stripped their clothes off, shall take up the body from the
clay or the stones, or from the plastered house,
and they shall lay it down on a place where they
know there are always corpse-eating dogs and corpse-eating
birds.
segments.zh: 『當鳥兒開始飛翔、植物開始生長、隱匿的洪水開始流動、風開始乾燥大地時，馬茲達的祭祀者應當在房屋牆上打開缺口，兩名強壯而技藝高超的男子應當脫去衣物，從泥土或石頭或粉刷過的房屋中取起軀體，他們應當將其放置在他們知道經常有食屍狗與食屍鳥的地方。

segments.orig:
aêtadha aête nasukasha nishhidhaêta avavat
haca iristaêibyô ýatha thrigâim, âat
vaocât ratush ashava mazdayasnaêibyô, mazdayasna
hãm aête maêsma barayen ýaêibyô
aête nasukasha frasnyåñte varesåsca tanûmca.
segments.en:
'Afterwards the corpse-bearers shall sit down, three paces
from the dead, and the holy Ratu shall proclaim to the worshippers
of Mazda thus: "Worshippers of Mazda, let the urine be brought
here wherewith the corpse-bearers there shall wash their hair
and their bodies!"'
segments.zh: 此後，屍體搬運者應坐下，距死者三步之地，聖潔的拉圖應向阿胡拉‧馬茲達的崇拜者如此宣布：「阿胡拉‧馬茲達的崇拜者啊，請把尿液帶來這裡，屍體搬運者應用它來洗淨他們的頭髮和身體！」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum cayô âat aête
maêsma anghen ashâum ahura mazda ýaêibyô
aête nasukasha frasnyåñte varesåsca tanûmca
pasvãm vâ staorãm vâ narãm vâ
nâirinãm vâ.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! Which is the
urine wherewith the corpse-bearers shall wash their hair and their
bodies? Is it of sheep or of oxen? Is it of man or of woman?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！屍體搬運者應用哪種尿液來洗淨他們的頭髮和身體？是羊的尿液還是牛的尿液？是男人的還是女人的？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, pasvãm vâ
staorãm vâ nôit narãm nôit nâirinãm
paraget dvaêibya ýôi anghen hvaêtvadathasca
hvaêtvadaithîshca aête maêsma maêzayañta
ýaêibyô aête nasukasha frasnyåñte
varesåsca tanûmca.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'It is of sheep or of oxen; not of man
nor of woman, except a man or a woman who has married the next-of-kin:
these shall therefore procure the urine wherewith the corpse-bearers
shall wash their hair and their bodies.'
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「是羊的或牛的；不是男人的或女人的，除非是已經與同宗血親結婚的男人或女人：他們應當因此提供尿液，屍體搬運者應用它來洗淨他們的頭髮和身體。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum ýôi patha uzbareñte
spânasca irista naraêca irista kat tå pathå
frayãn pasvãm vâ staorãm vâ narãm
vâ nâirinãm vâ âtrem vâ ahurahe
mazdå puthrem baresma vâ ashaya frastaretem.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! Can the way,
whereon the carcasses of dogs or corpses of men have been carried,
be passed through again by flocks and herds, by men and women,
by the fire of Ahura Mazda, by the consecrated bundles of Baresma,
and by the faithful?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！曾經運送過狗屍體或人屍體的那條路，能否再被畜羣和牲畜、男人和女人、阿胡拉‧馬茲達的火焰、祝聖的薩斯瑪束和信徒通過？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, nôit tå
pathå frayãn pasvãm nôit staorãm
nôit narãm nôit nâirinãm nôit
âtrem ahurahe mazdå puthrem nôit baresma ashaya
frastaretem.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'It cannot be passed through again by
flocks and herds, nor by men and women, nor by the fire of Ahura
Mazda, nor by the consecrated bundles of Baresma, nor by the faithful.
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「那條路不能再被畜羣和牲畜通過，不能被男人和女人通過，不能被阿胡拉‧馬茲達的火焰通過，不能被祝聖的薩斯瑪束通過，不能被信徒通過。

segments.orig:
spânem zairitem cathru-cashmem spaêtem zairi-gaoshem
âthritîm tadha aêtå pathå vîvâdhayañtu,
aiwi-niticit spitama zarathushtra spânem zairitem cathru-cashmem
spaêtem zairi-gaoshem aêsha druxsh ýâ
nasush apa- dvãsaiti apâxedhraêibyô naêmaêibyô.
segments.en:
'They shall therefore cause a yellow dog with four eyes, or
a white dog with yellow ears, to go three times through that way.
When either the yellow dog with four eyes, or the white dog with
yellow ears, is brought there, then the Druj Nasu flies away to
the regions of the north, [in the shape of a raging fly, with
knees and tail sticking out, droning without end, and like unto
the foulest Khrafstras.]
segments.zh: 他們應當因此令一隻黃色四眼的狗，或一隻白色黃耳的狗，三次通過那條路。當黃色四眼的狗，或白色黃耳的狗被帶到那裡時，德魯格‧納蘇便飛往北方諸地域〔以狂暴的蒼蠅之形，膝蓋與尾巴突出，無終地嗡鳴，且如同最汙穢的克拉夫斯特拉斯。〕

segments.orig:

zairitem cathru-cashmem nôit spaêtem zairi-gaoshem
xshvazhayacit tadha aêtå pathå vîvâdhayañtu,

segments.en:
'If the dog goes unwillingly, O Spitama Zarathushtra, they
shall cause the yellow dog with four eyes, or the white dog with
yellow ears, to go six times through that way. When either the
yellow dog with four eyes, or the white dog with yellow ears,
is brought there, then the Druj Nasu flies away to the regions
of the north, [in the shape of a raging fly, with knees and tail
sticking out, droning without end, and like unto the foulest Khrafstras.]
segments.zh: 「如果狗不願前往，斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉啊，他們應當令黃色四眼的狗，或白色黃耳的狗，六次通過那條路。當黃色四眼的狗，或白色黃耳的狗被帶到那裡時，德魯格‧納蘇便飛往北方諸地域〔以狂暴的蒼蠅之形，膝蓋與尾巴突出，無終地嗡鳴，且如同最汙穢的克拉夫斯特拉斯。〕」

zairitem cathru-cashmem nôit spaêtem zairi-gaoshem
nâumayâcit tadha aêtå pathå vîvâdhayañtu,

'If the dog goes unwillingly, they shall cause the yellow
dog with four eyes, or the white dog with yellow ears, to go nine
times through that way. When either the yellow dog with four eyes,
or the white dog with yellow ears, has been brought there, then
the Druj Nasu flies away to the regions of the north, [in the
shape of a raging fly, with knees and tail sticking out, droning
without end, and like unto the foulest Khrafstras.]
segments.zh: 「如果狗不願前往，他們應當令黃色四眼的狗，或白色黃耳的狗，九次通過那條路。當黃色四眼的狗，或白色黃耳的狗被帶到那裡時，德魯格‧納蘇便飛往北方諸地域〔以狂暴的蒼蠅之形，膝蓋與尾巴突出，無終地嗡鳴，且如同最汙穢的克拉夫斯特拉斯。〕」

segments.orig:
ýezi nôit ... zairi-gaoshem âthrava paoirîm
aêtå pathå frayañtu vârethrakhnîsh
vacô framrû, ýathâ ahû vairyô
... vâstârem.
segments.en:
'An Athravan shall first go along the way and shall say aloud
these victorious words: " Yatha aha vairyo : - The will of
the Lord is the law of righteousness.
'"The gifts of Vohu-mano to the deeds done in this world
for Mazda.
'"He who relieves the poor makes Ahura king.
segments.zh: 阿塔爾瓦的祭司應首先沿著這道路前行，並大聲說出這些勝利的言詞：「雅塔‧阿哈‧瓦伊里奧：主的意志乃正義之律。」「善思之神賜予在此世為馬茲達所作之行為的禮物。」「凡救濟貧困者，使阿胡拉為王。」

segments.orig:
kêm-nâ mazdâ ... frâvaocâ, kê
verethrem jâ ... kahmâicît.
segments.en:
'" Kem-na mazda :
- What protector hast thou given unto
me, O Mazda! while the hate of the wicked encompasses me? Whom
but thy Atar and Vohu-mano, through whose work I keep on the world
of righteousness? Reveal therefore to me thy Religion as thy rule!
'"Ke verethrem-ja: - Who is the victorious who will protect
thy teaching? Make it clear that I am the guide for both worlds.
May Sraosha come with Vohu-mano and help whomsoever thou pleasest,
O Mazda!
segments.zh: 「克姆‧那‧馬茲達：啊馬茲達，當惡人的仇恨籠罩於我時，汝曾賜予我何等的護者？除汝之阿塔爾與善思之神外，誰能使我得以保持正義之世界？因此向我揭示汝之宗教乃汝之律法！」「克‧瓦雷斯雷姆：誰是勝利者將護衛汝之教誨？明示我乃兩個世界的嚮導。願斯勞沙偕同善思之神而來，助予汝所悅納者，啊馬茲達！」

segments.orig:
pâta-nô tbishyañtat pairi mazdåsca
ârmaitishca speñtasca, nase daêvî druxsh
nase daêvô-cithre nase daêvô-frakarshte
nase daêvô-fradâiti apa druxsh nase apa druxsh
dvâra apa druxsh vînase apâxedhre apa-nasyehe
mâmereñcainîsh gaêthå astvaitîsh
ashahe.
segments.en:
'"Keep us from our hater, O Mazda and Armaiti Spenta!
Perish, O fiendish Druj! Perish, O brood of the fiend! Perish,
O creation of the fiend! Perish, O world of the fiend! Perish
away, O Druj! Rush away, O Druj! Perish away, O Druj! Perish away
to the regions of the north, never more to give unto death the
living world of Righteousness!"
segments.zh: 「守護我等免於我等之仇敵，啊馬茲達與聖者斯彭塔‧阿爾邁提！德魯格啊，滅亡！邪靈之種啊，滅亡！邪靈之造物啊，滅亡！邪靈之世界啊，滅亡！德魯格啊，消滅！德魯格啊，奔逃！德魯格啊，消滅！德魯格啊，消滅至北方之域，永不再對正義之活世界施以死亡！」

segments.orig:
vasô pascaêta mazdayasna aêtå pathå
frayãn pasvãm vâ staorãm vâ narãm
vâ nâirinãm vâ âtrem vâ ahurahe
mazdå puthrem baresma vâ ashaya frastaretem, vasô

segments.en:
'Then the worshippers of Mazda may at their will bring by
those ways sheep and oxen, men and women, and Fire, the son of
Ahura Mazda, the consecrated bundles of Baresma, and the faithful.
'The worshippers of Mazda may afterwards prepare meals with meat
and wine in that house; it shall be clean, and there will be no
sin, as before.'
segments.zh: 其後馬茲達的信奉者可隨其意志沿著這些道路攜帶羊群與牲畜、男人與女人，以及阿胡拉‧馬茲達之子阿塔爾、聖別的祆教祭壇木束、與忠信的信眾。馬茲達的信奉者其後可在該宅第中備製含肉與酒的食物；該宅第應為潔淨的，將不存罪惡，如同之前一樣。

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum ýô vastrem upangharezaiti
upairi aêtem iristem ubdaênem vâ îzaênem
vâ avavat aipi ýatha narsh aothravana kâ hê
asti citha, âat mraot ahurô mazdå, cathwârô
sata upâzananãm upâzôit aspahe ashtraya
cathwârô sata sraoshô-caranaya.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If a man shall
throw clothes, either of skin or woven, upon a dead body, enough
to cover the feet, what is the penalty that he shall pay? Ahura
Mazda answered: 'Four hundred stripes with the Aspahe-astra, four
hundred stripes with the Sraosho-charana.'

segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If a man voluntarily
commits the unnatural sin, what is the penalty for it? What is
the atonement for it? What is the cleansing from it?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'For that deed there is nothing that can
pay, nothing that can atone, nothing that can cleanse from it;
it is a trespass for which there is no atonement, for ever and
ever.'
segments.zh:
物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！若一人自願犯下違反自然之罪，其刑罰為何？其贖罪為何？其淨禮為何？

阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「為此惡行，無物可償，無物可贖，無物可淨；此為無贖罪之過犯，永遠永遠無贖。」

segments.orig: kva aêva ... perenâyush cithãm thweresaiti.
segments.en:
When is it so?
'It is so if the sinner be a professor of the Religion of Mazda,
or one who has been taught in it.
'But if he be not a professor of the Religion of Mazda, nor one
who has been taught in it, then his sin is taken from him, if
he makes confession of the Religion of Mazda and resolves never
to commit again such forbidden deeds.
'The Religion of Mazda indeed, O Spitama Zarathushtra! takes
away from him who makes confession of it the bonds of his sin;
it takes away (the sin of) breach of trust; it takes away (the
sin of) murdering one of the faithful; it takes away (the sin
of) burying a corpse; it takes away (the sin of) deeds for which
there is no atonement; it takes away the worst sin of usury; it
takes away any sin that may be sinned.
In the same way the Religion of Mazda, O Spitama Zarathushtra!
cleanses the faithful from every evil thought, word, and deed,
as a swift-rushing mighty wind cleanses the plain.
'So let all the deeds he doeth be henceforth good, O Zarathushtra!
a full atonement for his sin is effected by means of the Religion
of Mazda.'
segments.zh:
何時是這樣呢？
「如果罪人是馬茲達宗教的信奉者，或已被教導於其中者，便是這樣。」
「但若他既非馬茲達宗教的信奉者，亦未被教導於其中，則他的罪孽會被從他身上除去，如果他認信馬茲達宗教，並決心永不再犯此等禁忌行為。」
「馬茲達宗教確實，啊斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉！從認信它者身上除去罪孽的束縛；它除去背信的罪；它除去謀殺信徒的罪；它除去埋藏屍體的罪；它除去無法贖罪的行為之罪；它除去最嚴重的高利貸罪；它除去任何可能被犯下的罪孽。」
「同樣地，馬茲達宗教，啊斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉！使信徒淨化於每一個邪惡的念頭、言語和行為，如同一股迅疾、強大的風淨化平原。」
「所以，從今以後，他所做的一切行為應當都是善的，啊查拉圖斯特拉！透過馬茲達宗教，他的罪孽得到了充分的贖罪。」

that is a male paramour of the Daevas? that is a female paramour
of the Daevas? that is a wife to the Daeva? that is as bad as

segments.en:

lies with womankind, or as woman lies with mankind, is the man
that is a Daeva; this one is the man that is a worshipper of the
Daevas, that is a male paramour of the Daevas, that is a female
paramour of the Daevas, that is a wife to the Daeva; this is the
man that is as bad as a Daeva, that is in his whole being a Daeva;
this is the man that is a Daeva before he dies, and becomes one
of the unseen Daevas after death: so is he, whether he has lain
with mankind as mankind, or as womankind.'
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『與人類交合如同男人與女人交合，或如同女人與男人交合的人，就是迭瓦人；此人就是迭瓦的祭祀者，迭瓦的男性伴侶，迭瓦的女性伴侶，迭瓦的妻子；此人就是與迭瓦一樣邪惡的人，在他的整個存在中都是迭瓦；此人在死前是迭瓦，死後成為無形迭瓦之一：無論他是如同人類般與人類交合，或如同女人般交合，他都是如此。』

他應當將腳跟壓在地上，並抬起腳趾；汝應當用水灑淋他的右腳趾；隨後德魯格‧納蘇撲向左腳趾。汝應當用水灑淋左腳趾；隨後德魯格‧納蘇以狂怒蒼蠅的形狀飛往北方地域，膝蓋與尾巴凸出，無盡地嗡嗡叫，宛如最醜陋的克拉夫斯特拉。
「啊馬茲達與斯彭塔‧阿爾邁提，守護我們遠離我們的仇恨者！德魯格，凶惡的德魯格啊，滅亡吧！兇靈的子嗣啊，滅亡吧！兇靈的造物啊，滅亡吧！兇靈的世界啊，滅亡吧！德魯格啊，滅亡遠去吧！德魯格啊，急速逃去吧！德魯格啊，滅亡遠去吧！德魯格啊，滅亡遠去到北方地域，再也不將死亡賦予正義的活生世界！」

O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If worshippers
of Mazda, walking, or running, or riding, or driving, come upon
a Nasu-burning fire, whereon Nasu is being burnt or cooked, what
shall they do?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！若阿胡拉‧馬茲達的信仰者們，行走著或奔跑著或騎馬或駕車而至，遇到一座納蘇焚燒之火，其上納蘇正被焚燒或烹煮，他們應當做什麼？

segments.orig:

segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'They shall kill the man that cooks
the Nasu; surely they shall kill him. They shall take off the
cauldron, they shall take off the tripod.
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『他們應當殺死烹煮納蘇的人；確實他們應當殺死他。他們應當取下大釜，他們應當取下三腳架。」

'Then they shall kindle wood from that fire; either wood of
those trees that have the seed of fire in them, or bundles of
the very wood that was prepared for that fire; then they shall
take it farther and disperse it, that it may die out the sooner.

'Wheresoever the wind shall bring the perfume of the fire,
thereunto the fire of Ahura Mazda shall go and kill thousands
of unseen Daevas, thousands of fiends, the brood of darkness,
thousands of couples of Yatus and Pairikas.'

segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If a man bring
a Nasu-burning fire to the Daityo-gatu, what shall be his reward
when his soul has parted with his body?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'His reward shall be the same as if he had,
here below, brought ten thousand fire-brands to the Daityo-gatu.'
segments.zh:
物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！如果一個人將納蘇焚火帶向戴提亞‧蓋圖，當他的靈魂離開身體時，他的回報是什麼？

阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「他的回報應如同他在此地下界曾將一萬根火焰枝條帶向戴提亞‧蓋圖一樣。」

阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「他的賞賜應與他在此下界奉獻三十枝火把給戴提亞之門相同。」
〔物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！若一人將田野之火奉獻給戴提亞之門，他的靈魂離開身體後將獲得何等賞賜？
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「他的賞賜應與他在此下界奉獻二十枝火把給戴提亞之門相同。」〕

segments.orig:
ýô âtrem skairyat haca ... vîsaiti
âtre-saokanãm.... ... ýô âtrem
nazdishtat haca ... âat mraot ahurô mazdå, ýatha
aêtahmi anghvô ýat astvaiñti dasa âtre-saokanãm
dâitîm gâtûm avi ava-baraiti!
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If a man bring
to the Daityo-gatu the fire of his own hearth, what shall be his
reward when his soul has parted with his body?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'His reward shall be the same as if he had,
here below, brought ten fire-brands to the Daityo-gatu.'
segments.zh:
物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！如果一個人將他自己爐灶的火帶到戴提亞‧蓋圖，當他的靈魂與身體分離時，他的報酬是什麼？
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「他的報酬應當與他在下界帶十支火把到戴提亞‧蓋圖的報酬相同。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum kat tâ nara ýaozhdayãn
anghen ashâum ahura mazda ýâ nasâum ava-hishta
dûire asahi razanghãm.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! Can a man be
made clean, O holy Ahura Mazda! who has touched a corpse in a
distant place in the wilderness?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！一個人在遠方的曠野中觸及屍體，他能夠被淨化嗎，聖者阿胡拉‧馬茲達？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, ýaozhdayãn
anghen ashâum zarathushtra, kva aêva, ýezi
aêsha nasush aiwi-khnixta sûnô vâ kerefsh-hvarô
vayô vâ kerefsh-hvarô âat hvãm
tanûm pairi- ýaozhdaithîta gêush maêsmana
thrisatathwem frasnâtêe thrisatathwem upa-snâtêe
akhryãm paiti usnâitîm.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'He can, O holy Zarathushtra.'
How so?
'If the Nasu has already been expelled by the corpse-eating dogs
or the corpse-eating birds, he shall wash his body with gomez;
he shall wash it thirty times, he shall rub it dry with the hand
thirty times, beginning every time with the head.
segments.zh:
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「他能夠被淨化，聖者查拉圖斯特拉。」
如何淨化？
「如果納蘇已經被食屍的狗或食屍的鳥驅逐，他應當用牛尿洗淨他的身體；他應當洗淨三十次，他應當用手擦乾三十次，每次都從頭部開始。」

segments.orig:
âat ýezi nasush anaiwi-khnixta sûnô
vâ kerefsh-hvarô vayô vâ kerefsh-hvarô
pañca-dasa frasnâtêe pañca-dasa upasnâtêe.
segments.en:
'If the Nasu has not yet been expelled by the corpse-eating
dogs or the corpse-eating birds, he shall wash his body with gomez;
he shall wash it fifteen times, he shall rub it dry with the hand
fifteen times.
segments.zh: 「如果納蘇尚未被食屍的狗或食屍的鳥驅逐，他應當用牛尿洗淨他的身體；他應當洗淨十五次，他應當用手擦乾十五次。」

segments.orig:
tacat paoirîm hâthrem frasha adhât tacôit
ýat dim kascit anghêush astvatô aêtadha
paiti ava-hishtêe berezyaoget vacô râzayãn,
idha iristahe tanûm ava-hishta anaêshem manô
anaêshem vacô anaêshem shyaothnem isaêta
mê ýaozhdâitîm, tacat paoirîm upâiti
ýezi dim nôit ýaozhdatheñte thrishûm
aêtahe shyaothnahe baxsheñti.
segments.en:
'Then he shall run a distance of a Hathra. He shall run until
he meets some man on his way, and he shall cry out aloud: "Here
am I, one who has touched the corpse of a man, and who is powerless
in mind, powerless in tongue, powerless in hand. Do make me clean."
Thus shall he run until he overtakes the man. If the man will
not cleanse him, he remits him the third of his trespass.
segments.zh: 「然後他應當奔跑一個哈特拉的距離。他應當奔跑直到在他的路上遇到某人，他應當大聲呼喊：『看啊，我在這裡，我觸及了一個人的屍體，我心靈無力，舌頭無力，手臂無力。請淨化我吧。』他應當這樣奔跑直到趕上那個人。如果那個人不願淨化他，他赦免他三分之一的罪孽。」

segments.orig:
tacat bitîm hâthrem ... bitîm upâiti,
ýezi dim nôit ýaozhdatheñte naêmem
aêtahe shyaothnahe baxsheñti.
segments.en:
'Then he shall run another Hathra, he shall run off again
until he overtakes a man; if the man will not cleanse him, he
remits him the half of his trespass.
segments.zh: 「然後他應當奔跑另一個哈特拉，他應當再次奔跑直到趕上一個人；如果那個人不願淨化他，他赦免他一半的罪孽。」

segments.orig:
tacat thritîm hâthrem ... thritîm upâiti,
ýezi dim nôit ýaozhdatheñte vîspem
aêtahe shyaothnahe baxsheñti.
segments.en:
'Then he shall run a third Hathra, he shall run off a third
time until he overtakes a man; if the man will not cleanse him,
he remits him the whole of his trespass.
segments.zh: 「然後他應當奔跑第三個哈特拉，他應當第三次奔跑直到趕上一個人；如果那個人不願淨化他，他赦免他全部的罪孽。」

segments.orig:
frasha adhât tacôit ýat dim nazdishtem
avi nmânemca vîsemca zañtûmca dah'yûmca
aêtadha paiti ava-hishtêe berezyaoget vacô râzayãn,
idha iristahe tanûm ava-hishta anaêshem manô
anaêshem vacô anaêshem shyaothnem isaêta
mê ýaozhdâitîm, ýezi dim nôit
ýaozhdatheñte âat hvãm tanûm
pairi-ýaozhdaithîta gêush maêsmana apâca
paiti avatha ýaozhdayãn.
segments.en:
'Thus shall he run forwards until he comes near a house, a
borough, a town, an inhabited district, and he shall cry out with
a loud voice: "Here am I, one who has touched the corpse
of a man, and who is powerless in mind, powerless in tongue, powerless
in hand. Do make me clean." If they will not cleanse him,
he shall cleanse his body with gomez and water; thus shall he
be clean.'
segments.zh: 「他應當這樣奔跑向前直到來到一座房屋、一個村落、一座城鎮、一個有人居住的地區附近，他應當大聲呼喊：『看啊，我在這裡，我觸及了一個人的屍體，我心靈無力，舌頭無力，手臂無力。請淨化我吧。』如果他們不願淨化他，他應當用牛尿和水淨化他的身體；這樣他就被淨化了。』」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... âat ýezi anghat âfsh añtarât
naêmât aête patha âfsh cithãm fraorisaiti
kâ hê asti citha.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If he find water
on his way and the water make him subject to a penalty, what is
the penalty that he shall pay?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！若他在途中遇到水，水使他受罰，他應當支付什麼罰金？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, cathwârô
sata upâzananãm upâzôit aspahe ashtraya
cathwârô sata sraoshô-caranaya.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Four hundred stripes with the Aspahe-astra,
four hundred stripes with the Sraosho-charana.'
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「以馬鞭四百下，以斯勞沙鞭四百下。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... âat ýezi anghat urvara añtarât
naêmât aête patha âtarsh cithãm
fraorisaiti kâ hê asti citha.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If he find trees
on his way and the fire make him subject to a penalty, what is
the penalty that he shall pay?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Four hundred stripes with the Aspahe-astra,
four hundred stripes with the Sraosho-charana.
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！若他在途中遇到樹木，火使他受罰，他應當支付什麼罰金？阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「以馬鞭四百下，以斯勞沙鞭四百下。」

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, cathwârô
... sraoshô-caranaya, hâ hê asti citha hâ
hê asti âperetish aipi- pâremnâi idha
ashaone nôit anaipi-pâremnâi drujô nmâne
haithyâ anghen astayô!
ashem vohû...!!
segments.en:
'This is the penalty, this is the atonement which saves the
faithful man who submits to it, not him who does not submit to
it.
Such a one shall surely be an inhabitant in the mansion of the
Druj.'
segments.zh: 「這就是罰金，這就是贖罪，使服從它的信徒得救，不服從它的人則否。如此的人必定居住在德魯格的宅邸。」
